evidence.observation: T followed the ramp setpoint closely; a 10 °C overshoot at the start of growth (760 °C) has settled to 750.0 °C
Holding steady at about 43-44% during growth, which fits the hold after the ramp
Ar within about 1 sccm of setpoint the whole run (200 sccm during purge, 100 sccm after)
Pressure stable at about 758.4-759.5 Torr, so no sign of a leak or exhaust blockage

args.missing_evidence: No sample characterization yet. The O2 exhaust sensor is not installed, so a small air leak cannot be ruled out directly. No reference [mean, sd] values have been provided for comparison.
